title: 3D Maze Generation + Pathfinding
physics_constraints: maze: 15x15 grid, DFS or Prim generation, each cell 2x2 units
walls: BoxGeometry height 3, collision raycaster distance ~0.6
pathfinding: BFS or A* from playerCell to exitCell
timer: starts on first movement, stops when playerCell equals exitCell
difficulty_analysis: L4 challenges: (1) Correct implementation of the DFS/Prim maze generation algorithm; (2) Converting a 2D grid maze into 3D wall geometry; (3) Precise wall collision detection; (4) Synchronized rendering of the 2D Canvas minimap; (5) Implementation of the BFS/A* pathfinding algorithm and 3D path visualization; (6) Resource cleanup when regenerating the maze; (7) Timer state management
